import argparse
import ctypes
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import time
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urljoin
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen


class Bridge:
    READ_COMMANDS = {
        "app.ping", "catalog.get_channels", "catalog.get_banners",
        "catalog.get_video_list", "catalog.search_video", "catalog.get_video_key",
        "catalog.get_video_detail", "catalog.get_channel_detail", "video.play",

    def __init__(self, app_dir):

            raise RuntimeError("The installed bridge requires Windows x64 Python")
        self.app_dir = Path(app_dir).resolve(strict=True)
        self.dll_path = self.app_dir / "electron_bridge.dll"

        os.environ["RUST_LOG"] = "error"

        self.dll.dmghg_service_new.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
        self.dll.dmghg_service_new.restype = ctypes.c_void_p

        self.dll.dmghg_service_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]

def installed_version(exe):
    """Read PE version metadata; the resolver rejects unsupported client versions."""
    version = ctypes.windll.version
    size = version.GetFileVersionInfoSizeW(str(exe), None)
    if not size:
        raise RuntimeError("Cannot read the installed application's version metadata")
    buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(size)
    if not version.GetFileVersionInfoW(str(exe), 0, size, buffer):
        raise RuntimeError("Cannot read application version info")
    info = ctypes.c_void_p()
    length = ctypes.c_uint()
    if not version.VerQueryValueW(buffer, "\\", ctypes.byref(info), ctypes.byref(length)):
        raise RuntimeError("Application version structure is missing")
    fields = ctypes.cast(info, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint32))
    if fields[0] != 0xFEEF04BD or length.value < 52:
        raise RuntimeError("Application version structure is invalid")
    return f"{fields[2] >> 16}.{fields[2] & 65535}.{fields[3] >> 16}"


def inspect(bridge, keyword):
    channels = bridge.call("catalog.get_channels")
    listing = bridge.call("catalog.get_video_list", {"page": 1})
    search = bridge.call("catalog.search_video", {"key": keyword, "page": "1"})
    videos = listing.get("items", [])
    if not channels or not videos or not search.get("items"):
        raise RuntimeError("Empty channel/list/search response; cannot certify a rule")
    selected = search["items"][0]
    detail = bridge.call("catalog.get_video_detail", {"id": str(selected["id"])})
    groups = detail.get("parts", [])
    episodes = sum(len(group.get("part", [])) for group in groups)
    if not episodes:
        raise RuntimeError("No real episodes in the detail response")
    group = next(g for g in groups if g.get("part"))
    payload = {"id": str(selected["id"]), "part": group["part"][0], "play": group["play"], "resolve": True}
    play = bridge.call("video.play", payload)
    variant = play["list"][play["default"]]
    media = media_probe(variant["url"], variant.get("headers"))

        "dll_sha256": hashlib.sha256(bridge.dll_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "no_desktop": True, "installed_version": bridge.version,
        "isolated_state_root": str(bridge.state_root),
        "channels": len(channels), "list_items": len(videos),
        "search_keyword": keyword, "search_items": len(search["items"]),
        "detail_id": selected["id"], "detail_title": detail.get("name"),

        "media": media, "mobile_standalone_verified": False,
        "dependency": "Windows installed electron_bridge.dll and resources/lua",

def media_probe(url, headers=None, depth=0):
    """Check actual bytes, never equate a play URL string with successful media."""
    request = Request(url, headers={**(headers or {}), "Range": "bytes=0-2047"})
    with urlopen(request, timeout=20) as response:
        chunk = response.read(2048)
        report = {"host": urlsplit(response.url).hostname, "status": response.status,
                "content_type": response.headers.get("Content-Type"), "bytes_read": len(chunk),
                "hls_manifest": chunk.lstrip().startswith(b"#EXTM3U")}
        if report["hls_manifest"] and depth < 2:
            text = chunk.decode("utf-8", "replace")
            uris = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith("#")]
            if uris:
                report["first_child"] = media_probe(urljoin(response.url, uris[0]), headers, depth + 1)
        return report


def decode_probe(bridge, variant, progress_seconds=0.2, deadline_seconds=16):
    """Use the installed libmpv decoder with null audio/video outputs; no window."""
    dll_dir = os.add_dll_directory(str(bridge.app_dir))
    mpv = ctypes.CDLL(str(bridge.app_dir / "libmpv-2.dll"))
    mpv.mpv_create.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    mpv.mpv_set_option_string.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
    mpv.mpv_initialize.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    mpv.mpv_command.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p)]
    mpv.mpv_get_property_string.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
    mpv.mpv_get_property_string.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    mpv.mpv_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    mpv.mpv_wait_event.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_double]
    mpv.mpv_wait_event.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
    mpv.mpv_terminate_destroy.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
    handle = mpv.mpv_create()
    if not handle:
        raise RuntimeError("The installed media decoder could not initialize")
    try:
        for key, value in {"vo": "null", "ao": "null", "terminal": "no", "load-scripts": "no",
                           "network-timeout": "12", "cache-secs": "2", "demuxer-max-bytes": "4M"}.items():
            if mpv.mpv_set_option_string(handle, key.encode(), value.encode()) < 0:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Cannot set headless decoder option {key}")
        headers = ",".join(f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in (variant.get("headers") or {}).items())
        if headers:
            mpv.mpv_set_option_string(handle, b"http-header-fields", headers.encode())
        if mpv.mpv_initialize(handle) < 0:
            raise RuntimeError("The installed decoder initialization failed")
        args = (ctypes.c_char_p * 4)(b"loadfile", variant["url"].encode(), b"replace", None)
        if mpv.mpv_command(handle, args) < 0:
            raise RuntimeError("The installed decoder rejected the media request")
        deadline = time.monotonic() + deadline_seconds
        facts = {}
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            mpv.mpv_wait_event(handle, 0.1)
            for key in ["audio-codec-name", "video-params/w", "video-params/h", "time-pos"]:
                ptr = mpv.mpv_get_property_string(handle, key.encode())
                if ptr:
                    try:
                        facts[key] = ctypes.string_at(ptr).decode("utf-8", "replace")
                    finally:
                        mpv.mpv_free(ptr)
            if facts.get("video-params/w") and float(facts.get("time-pos", "0")) > progress_seconds:
                break
        facts["decoded_video"] = bool(facts.get("video-params/w")) and float(facts.get("time-pos", "0")) > progress_seconds
        facts["outputs"] = {"audio": "null", "video": "null"}
        return facts
    finally:
        mpv.mpv_terminate_destroy(handle)
        dll_dir.close()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--app-dir", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--keyword", default="仙逆")
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--show-play-schema", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--decode", action="store_true", help="Verify actual video decoding with no window/audio output")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    bridge = Bridge(args.app_dir)
    try:
        report, play = inspect(bridge, args.keyword)
        if args.decode:
            report["decoder"] = decode_probe(bridge, play["list"][play["default"]])
        if args.show_play_schema:
            # Show keys/types and bounded non-URL metadata only; never dump signed links.
            print(json.dumps({k: type(v).__name__ for k, v in play.items()}, ensure_ascii=False))
        output = Path(args.output)
        output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        output.write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False))
        if args.decode and not report["decoder"]["decoded_video"]:
            raise RuntimeError("Media bytes exist but headless decoding was not verified")
    finally:
        bridge.close()

    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")
    main()

"""DMGHG Local Bridge Service

Provides an isolated, read-only bridge service to electron_bridge.dll for HikerView.
Listens exclusively on 127.0.0.1 on permitted ports (18000, 18001, 18002; default 18002).
"""

import argparse
import ctypes
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
from socketserver import ThreadingMixIn


class Bridge:
    READ_COMMANDS = {
        "app.ping",
        "catalog.get_channels",
        "catalog.get_banners",
        "catalog.get_video_list",
        "catalog.search_video",
        "catalog.get_video_key",
        "catalog.get_video_detail",
        "catalog.get_channel_detail",
        "video.play",
    }

    def __init__(self, app_dir: str):
        if os.name != "nt":
            raise RuntimeError("The installed bridge requires Windows x64 Python")
        self.app_dir = Path(app_dir).resolve(strict=True)
        self.dll_path = self.app_dir / "electron_bridge.dll"
        if not self.dll_path.is_file():
            raise RuntimeError("electron_bridge.dll is missing from the selected application directory")

        self.state_root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dmghg-bridge-"))
        os.environ["DMGHG_TEST_DATA_ROOT"] = str(self.state_root)
        os.environ["RUST_LOG"] = "error"

        self.dll = ctypes.CDLL(str(self.dll_path))
        self.dll.dmghg_service_new.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
        self.dll.dmghg_service_new.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        self.dll.dmghg_service_handle_command_json.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
        self.dll.dmghg_service_handle_command_json.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        self.dll.dmghg_string_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        self.dll.dmghg_service_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]

        self.lock = threading.RLock()
        self.version = self._read_installed_version(self.app_dir / "dmghg.exe")
        self.handle = self.dll.dmghg_service_new(b"dmghg-flutter", self.version.encode("ascii"))
        if not self.handle:
            raise RuntimeError("The installed bridge service could not initialize")

    @staticmethod
    def _read_installed_version(exe_path: Path) -> str:
        version = ctypes.windll.version
        size = version.GetFileVersionInfoSizeW(str(exe_path), None)
        if not size:
            raise RuntimeError("Cannot read the installed application's version metadata")
        buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(size)
        if not version.GetFileVersionInfoW(str(exe_path), 0, size, buffer):
            raise RuntimeError("Cannot read application version info")
        info = ctypes.c_void_p()
        length = ctypes.c_uint()
        if not version.VerQueryValueW(buffer, "\\", ctypes.byref(info), ctypes.byref(length)):
            raise RuntimeError("Application version structure is missing")
        fields = ctypes.cast(info, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint32))
        if fields[0] != 0xFEEF04BD or length.value < 52:
            raise RuntimeError("Application version structure is invalid")
        return f"{fields[2] >> 16}.{fields[2] & 65535}.{fields[3] >> 16}"

    def call(self, command: str, payload: dict = None):
        if command not in self.READ_COMMANDS:
            raise ValueError(f"Command '{command}' is outside the read-only inspection allowlist")

        request = {
            "request_id": "bridge-rpc",
            "protocol_version": 1,
            "command": command,
            "payload": payload or {},
        }

        with self.lock:
            previous_cwd = Path.cwd()
            try:
                # The installed Lua resolver requires Cwd to find resources/lua
                os.chdir(self.app_dir)
                raw_req = json.dumps(request, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
                ptr = self.dll.dmghg_service_handle_command_json(self.handle, raw_req)
                if not ptr:
                    raise RuntimeError("Bridge returned a null response")
                try:
                    resp_str = ctypes.string_at(ptr).decode("utf-8")
                    response = json.loads(resp_str)
                finally:
                    self.dll.dmghg_string_free(ptr)
            finally:
                os.chdir(previous_cwd)

        if response.get("ok") is not True:
            err = response.get("error", {})
            code = err.get("code", "unknown_error")
            msg = err.get("message", "Unknown bridge failure")
            raise RuntimeError(f"{code}: {msg}")

        return response.get("data")

    def close(self):
        with self.lock:
            if self.handle:
                try:
                    self.dll.dmghg_service_free(self.handle)
                except Exception:
                    pass
                self.handle = None


class ThreadedHTTPServer(ThreadingMixIn, HTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True


class BridgeHTTPHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    timeout = 8.0  # Server-side timeout for socket reads
    MAX_BODY_SIZE = 1024 * 1024  # 1 MB maximum request body

    def setup(self):
        super().setup()
        self.request.settimeout(8.0)

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        # Silent by default
        pass

    def _send_json(self, status_code: int, data: dict):
        body = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status_code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self.send_response(204)
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        self.end_headers()

    def do_GET(self):
        path = self.path.split("?")[0].rstrip("/")
        if path == "" or path == "/ping":
            self._send_json(200, {
                "ok": True,
                "service": "dmghg-bridge",
                "version": self.server.bridge.version,
            })
            return

        if path == "/channels":
            try:
                channels = self.server.bridge.call("catalog.get_channels")
                self._send_json(200, {"ok": True, "data": channels})
            except Exception as e:
                self._send_json(500, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "bridge_error", "message": str(e)}})
            return

        self._send_json(404, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "not_found", "message": f"Route '{self.path}' not found"}})

    def do_POST(self):
        path = self.path.split("?")[0].rstrip("/")
        if path != "/call":
            self._send_json(404, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "not_found", "message": f"Route '{self.path}' not found"}})
            return

        try:
            length_header = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
            if not length_header:
                self._send_json(411, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "length_required", "message": "Content-Length required"}})
                return
            content_length = int(length_header)
            if content_length > self.MAX_BODY_SIZE:
                self._send_json(413, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "payload_too_large", "message": "Payload exceeds 1MB limit"}})
                return

            post_data = self.rfile.read(content_length)
            req_json = json.loads(post_data.decode("utf-8"))
        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as e:
            self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "invalid_json", "message": str(e)}})
            return
        except Exception as e:
            self._send_json(408, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "request_timeout", "message": str(e)}})
            return

        command = req_json.get("command")
        payload = req_json.get("payload")

        if not command:
            self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "missing_command", "message": "Field 'command' is required"}})
            return

        if command not in self.server.bridge.READ_COMMANDS:
            self._send_json(403, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "forbidden_command", "message": f"Command '{command}' is not permitted"}})
            return

        try:
            result = self.server.bridge.call(command, payload)
            self._send_json(200, {"ok": True, "data": result})
        except Exception as e:
            self._send_json(500, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "bridge_error", "message": str(e)}})


def run_server(app_dir: str, port: int):
    allowed_ports = {18000, 18001, 18002}
    if port not in allowed_ports:
        raise ValueError(f"Port {port} is not in the permitted local engine ports {allowed_ports}")

    bridge = Bridge(app_dir)
    server = ThreadedHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), BridgeHTTPHandler)
    server.bridge = bridge

    print(f"DMGHG Bridge running on [REDACTED_URL] (PID: {os.getpid()}, Version: {bridge.version})", flush=True)

    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()
        bridge.close()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="DMGHG Local Isolated Bridge HTTP Server")
    parser.add_argument("--app-dir", required=True, help="Path to installed 动漫共和国 directory")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=18002, choices=[18000, 18001, 18002], help="Loopback port (18000, 18001, 18002)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    run_server(args.app_dir, args.port)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

## 三、海阔视界内置同构函数 API 全集 (Isomorphic API Reference)

移动端 Rhino/QuickJS 与 PC 桌面端 V8 均原生支持的标准内置函数：

### 1. 网络请求类
- **`request(url, options)`**：
  - 同步阻塞 HTTP 请求；
  - `options` 参数字典：
    ```javascript
    {
      method: 'GET' | 'POST',
      headers: { 'User-Agent': '...', 'Referer': '...', 'Cookie': '...' },
      body: '...', // POST 请求体 (String)
      timeout: 10000 // 超时毫秒
    }
    ```
  - 返回值：HTTP 响应体字符串文本。
- **`post(url, options)`**：
  - POST 请求快捷方法，同 `request(url, { ...options, method: 'POST' })`。
- **`fetch(url, options)`**：
  - 部分旧版移动端海阔视界的别名方法，双端同构开发时优先推荐使用 `request()`。

### 2. DOM / CSS 选择器类 (MyJsoup / Cheerio)
- **`pdfa(html, selector)`**：
  - 提取符合 CSS 选择器的所有 DOM 节点，返回包含 HTML 片段的字符串数组 `string[]`；
  - ⚠️ **死刑铁律**：严禁在 `selector` 中使用英文逗号 `,`！
- **`pdfh(html, selector)`**：
  - 提取单个节点的属性值或文本内容；
  - 常用提取语法：
    - `".title&&Text"`：提取文本（自动剔除内部 HTML 标签）；
    - `"a&&href"`：提取 href 属性；
    - `"img&&src"` 或 `"img&&data-original"`：提取图片链接；
    - `".content&&Html"`：提取内联原始 HTML。
- **`pd(html, selector, baseUrl)`**：
  - 提取属性并根据 `baseUrl` 自动转换为绝对路径（免手写 URL 拼接）。

### 3. 本地键值持久化存储 (Storage)
- **`setItem(key, value)`**：持久化写入数据（String），双端本地独立加密存储。
- **`getItem(key, defaultValue)`**：读取持久化存储，若不存在则返回 `defaultValue`。
- **`clearItem(key)`**：删除指定 Key 的存储数据。

### 4. 驱动与结果呈现
- **`setResult(items)`**：
  - 海阔核心卡片驱动入口；
  - `items` 必须是包含上述 `col_type` 规范对象的数组；
  - 严禁直接 return 数组，必须通过 `setResult(items)` 驱动渲染。

### 5. 交互与状态反馈
- **`toast(message)`**：在屏幕底部弹出提示气泡。
- **`showLoading(text)`** / **`hideLoading()`**：唤起或关闭加载指示器。

"""DMGHG Local Isolated Bridge HTTP Server

Provides an isolated, read-only bridge service to electron_bridge.dll for HikerView.
Listens exclusively on 127.0.0.1 on permitted ports (18000, 18001, 18002; default 18002).
"""

import argparse
import ctypes
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
from socketserver import ThreadingMixIn
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse


class Bridge:
    READ_COMMANDS = {
        "app.ping",
        "catalog.get_channels",
        "catalog.get_banners",
        "catalog.get_video_list",
        "catalog.search_video",
        "catalog.get_video_key",
        "catalog.get_video_detail",
        "catalog.get_channel_detail",
        "video.play",
    }

    def __init__(self, app_dir: str):
        if os.name != "nt":
            raise RuntimeError("The installed bridge requires Windows x64 Python")
        self.app_dir = Path(app_dir).resolve(strict=True)
        self.dll_path = self.app_dir / "electron_bridge.dll"
        if not self.dll_path.is_file():
            raise RuntimeError("electron_bridge.dll is missing from the selected application directory")

        self.state_root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="dmghg-bridge-"))
        os.environ["DMGHG_TEST_DATA_ROOT"] = str(self.state_root)
        os.environ["RUST_LOG"] = "error"

        self.dll = ctypes.CDLL(str(self.dll_path))
        self.dll.dmghg_service_new.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
        self.dll.dmghg_service_new.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        self.dll.dmghg_service_handle_command_json.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_char_p]
        self.dll.dmghg_service_handle_command_json.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
        self.dll.dmghg_string_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]
        self.dll.dmghg_service_free.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]

        self.lock = threading.RLock()
        self.version = self._read_installed_version(self.app_dir / "dmghg.exe")
        self.handle = self.dll.dmghg_service_new(b"dmghg-flutter", self.version.encode("ascii"))
        if not self.handle:
            raise RuntimeError("The installed bridge service could not initialize")

    @staticmethod
    def _read_installed_version(exe_path: Path) -> str:
        version = ctypes.windll.version
        size = version.GetFileVersionInfoSizeW(str(exe_path), None)
        if not size:
            raise RuntimeError("Cannot read the installed application's version metadata")
        buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(size)
        if not version.GetFileVersionInfoW(str(exe_path), 0, size, buffer):
            raise RuntimeError("Cannot read application version info")
        info = ctypes.c_void_p()
        length = ctypes.c_uint()
        if not version.VerQueryValueW(buffer, "\\", ctypes.byref(info), ctypes.byref(length)):
            raise RuntimeError("Application version structure is missing")
        fields = ctypes.cast(info, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_uint32))
        if fields[0] != 0xFEEF04BD or length.value < 52:
            raise RuntimeError("Application version structure is invalid")
        return f"{fields[2] >> 16}.{fields[2] & 65535}.{fields[3] >> 16}"

    def call(self, command: str, payload: dict = None):
        if command not in self.READ_COMMANDS:
            raise ValueError(f"Command '{command}' is outside the read-only inspection allowlist")

        request = {
            "request_id": "bridge-rpc",
            "protocol_version": 1,
            "command": command,
            "payload": payload or {},
        }

        with self.lock:
            previous_cwd = Path.cwd()
            try:
                # The installed Lua resolver requires Cwd to find resources/lua
                os.chdir(self.app_dir)
                raw_req = json.dumps(request, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
                ptr = self.dll.dmghg_service_handle_command_json(self.handle, raw_req)
                if not ptr:
                    raise RuntimeError("Bridge returned a null response")
                try:
                    resp_str = ctypes.string_at(ptr).decode("utf-8")
                    response = json.loads(resp_str)
                finally:
                    self.dll.dmghg_string_free(ptr)
            finally:
                os.chdir(previous_cwd)

        if response.get("ok") is not True:
            err = response.get("error", {})
            code = err.get("code", "unknown_error")
            msg = err.get("message", "Unknown bridge failure")
            raise RuntimeError(f"{code}: {msg}")

        return response.get("data")

    def close(self):
        with self.lock:
            if self.handle:
                try:
                    self.dll.dmghg_service_free(self.handle)
                except Exception:
                    pass
                self.handle = None


class ThreadedHTTPServer(ThreadingMixIn, HTTPServer):
    daemon_threads = True
    allow_reuse_address = True


class BridgeHTTPHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    timeout = 8.0  # Server-side timeout for socket reads
    MAX_BODY_SIZE = 1024 * 1024  # 1 MB maximum request body

    def setup(self):
        super().setup()
        self.request.settimeout(8.0)

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        # Silent by default
        pass

    def handle(self):
        try:
            super().handle()
        except (socket.timeout, TimeoutError):
            pass

    def _send_json(self, status_code: int, data: dict):
        body = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status_code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_OPTIONS(self):
        self.send_response(204)
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        self.end_headers()

    def do_GET(self):
        parsed = urlparse(self.path)
        path = parsed.path.rstrip("/")
        if path == "" or path == "/ping":
            self._send_json(200, {
                "ok": True,
                "service": "dmghg-bridge",
                "version": self.server.bridge.version,
            })
            return

        if path == "/channels":
            try:
                channels = self.server.bridge.call("catalog.get_channels")
                self._send_json(200, {"ok": True, "data": channels})
            except Exception as e:
                self._send_json(500, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "bridge_error", "message": str(e)}})
            return

        if path == "/play":
            qs = parse_qs(parsed.query)
            id_val = qs.get("id", [""])[0]
            part_val = qs.get("part", [""])[0]
            play_val = qs.get("play", [""])[0]
            if not id_val:
                self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "missing_id", "message": "Query parameter 'id' is required"}})
                return
            try:
                play_data = self.server.bridge.call("video.play", {
                    "id": str(id_val),
                    "part": part_val,
                    "play": play_val,
                    "resolve": True
                })
                self._send_json(200, {"ok": True, "data": play_data})
            except Exception as e:
                self._send_json(500, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "bridge_error", "message": str(e)}})
            return

        self._send_json(404, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "not_found", "message": f"Route '{self.path}' not found"}})

    def do_POST(self):
        parsed = urlparse(self.path)
        path = parsed.path.rstrip("/")
        if path != "/call":
            self._send_json(404, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "not_found", "message": f"Route '{self.path}' not found"}})
            return

        try:
            length_header = self.headers.get("Content-Length")
            if not length_header:
                self._send_json(411, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "length_required", "message": "Content-Length header required"}})
                return
            content_length = int(length_header)
            if content_length > self.MAX_BODY_SIZE:
                self._send_json(413, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "payload_too_large", "message": "Payload exceeds 1MB limit"}})
                return

            post_data = self.rfile.read(content_length)
            if len(post_data) < content_length:
                self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "incomplete_body", "message": "Incomplete request body"}})
                return
            req_json = json.loads(post_data.decode("utf-8"))
        except (socket.timeout, TimeoutError):
            try:
                self._send_json(408, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "request_timeout", "message": "Request read timed out"}})
            except Exception:
                pass
            return
        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as e:
            self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "invalid_json", "message": str(e)}})
            return
        except Exception as e:
            self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "bad_request", "message": str(e)}})
            return

        command = req_json.get("command")
        payload = req_json.get("payload")

        if not command:
            self._send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "missing_command", "message": "Field 'command' is required"}})
            return

        if command not in self.server.bridge.READ_COMMANDS:
            self._send_json(403, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "forbidden_command", "message": f"Command '{command}' is not in the read allowlist"}})
            return

        try:
            result = self.server.bridge.call(command, payload)
            self._send_json(200, {"ok": True, "data": result})
        except Exception as e:
            self._send_json(500, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "bridge_error", "message": str(e)}})


def run_server(app_dir: str, port: int):
    allowed_ports = {18000, 18001, 18002}
    if port not in allowed_ports:
        print(f"Warning: Port {port} is outside standard Hiker permitted ports {allowed_ports}", file=sys.stderr)

    bridge = Bridge(app_dir)
    server = ThreadedHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), BridgeHTTPHandler)
    server.bridge = bridge

    print(f"DMGHG Bridge running on [REDACTED_URL] (PID: {os.getpid()}, Version: {bridge.version})", flush=True)

    try:
        server.serve_forever()
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    finally:
        server.server_close()
        bridge.close()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="DMGHG Local Isolated Bridge HTTP Server")
    parser.add_argument("--app-dir", required=True, help="Path to installed 动漫共和国 directory")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=18002, help="Loopback port (default: 18002; allowed: 18000, 18001, 18002)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    run_server(args.app_dir, args.port)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
